summary: Master the art of resilience and risk management with our specialized training. Learn to optimize inventory agility and drive success in your organization.
lede: Supply chain resilience and inventory agility training helps supply chain managers and inventory analysts assess disruption risks and adjust stock buffers. It covers multi-tier network mapping, recovery and survival time calculations, multi-echelon inventory optimization, and supplier continuity assessments. The syllabus also addresses risk monitoring dashboards and operational disruption response playbooks.
audienceIntro: This intermediate to advanced programme is tailored for cross-functional professionals responsible for maintaining continuity, optimizing working capital, and mitigating operational risks across complex global or regional supply chains.
modules: Supply Chain Vulnerability and Risk Foundations
Supply Network Mapping and Disruption Metrics
Dynamic Inventory Optimization and Buffer Strategies
Supplier Risk Auditing and Resilient Contracting
Supply Chain Control Towers and Digital Visibility
Disruption Response Playbooks and Continuity Management
Resilience Strategy Integration and Executive Governance
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of three years of professional experience in supply chain management, inventory planning, procurement, logistics, or operational risk. A working knowledge of foundational inventory concepts such as safety stock, lead times, and bill of materials, along with intermediate proficiency in spreadsheet-based data analysis using Microsoft Excel, is required. No programming or software coding experience is needed.
